name: OATS
author: OATS Framework
description: OATS on Omarchy: an OATS icon in the bar whose panel shows the agents waiting on you as cards, read when you open it, and opens their sessions, the TUI and the Desktop; the same cards in a popup from the oats menu; and a setup script for launchers, keys, an oats menu and the default UI that OATS opens in SUPER + SPACE.

barWidget.description: A panel, read fresh each time it opens, that shows the agents waiting on you and opens their sessions, the OATS TUI and Desktop, and setup.
